items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I remember Milt Hinton telling me about some time when he was with one of these bands...

ctx.x: I remember Milt Hinton telling me about some time when he was with one of these bands (I can't remember which one), and there was like this little room underneath the bandstand. And they got locked in there. And they heard all these guys outside who were talking about setting fire to the building.

Yeah. Well, we never had nothing like that. But we ran into... When we more or less stopped playing and didn't ...(?)..., there'd be some guy who got drunk. While we was in Oddlow, Oklahoma, playing on the second floor for a man who had a dance hall up there, with the White police, in a White place(?) and everything. And the boss man paid us off at 11 o'clock. We had to play til 12. And he paid us off, and then he left. The people were just sitting there ...(?)... We had to play til 12 so the people could get…
